en.quote: It [the Constitution], in my view, is inviolable.
en.head: Constitutional amendments were proposed less than a month later.
en.body: On 15 January 2020, Putin proposed a broad package of constitutional amendments. The amendment law was signed in March, and the changes took effect that summer. “Inviolable” was an assessment, not a pledge never to amend the text, but the subsequent initiative sits uneasily with that public characterisation.
en.meta_context: Annual press conference, on the Constitution
